tasks.title: Production Browser QA Verification — Hair Journey Signup / Login Nonce Fix (v3.2.3)
tasks.description: Verify that the v3.2.3 fix omitting X-WP-Nonce on public auth endpoints enables real user registration, login, and Mya chat-token minting without HTTP 403 cookie check rejections in live production.
tasks.creator: Winston
acceptance_criteria: Browser omits X-WP-Nonce header on POST /auth/register and /auth/login
Real registration succeeds in browser (HTTP 201 Created)
Login functions without 403 cookie check failure (HTTP 401 application validation)
Authenticated session mints Mya chat token (HTTP 200 OK)
Reusable QA credentials documented in community/secrets/test_credentials.md

verification_evidence.details: Browser network intercept verified X-WP-Nonce omission on public endpoints. Real user account #18 created with HTTP 201. Login responded HTTP 401. Chat token minted HTTP 200.

tasks.creator: Meridian
